comment: A composed docker lives in a library of its own and opens in every layout. Runs on a profile whose data root holds composed_dockers.cfg with one docker, composed_1 called Brush and Eraser, of the Toolbox's Brush Tool and Eraser Tool, seeded by hand before the run. The docker is shown from the Window menu's registry, holds the two tool views, lights the eraser when it is in the hand, is saved open into a layout, closed by a layout that never named it, listed in the Window menu, opened again by the layout that did, and has its page in Preferences with no Reset to shipped row, having nothing shipped.
